[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Kaldaar''' was a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Kaldaar conducted experiments directly on living [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] individuals, such as [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] prisoners. Most of them did not survived those experiments.<ref name="SWG:JoDK" />
